rows.note: This is the all-purpose modifier for things relating to bodily functions or physiology.

example.english: These physiological reactions are perfectly normal, so don't worry so much.
example.traditional: 呢啲生理反應好正常，唔使咁擔心。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 sang1 lei5 faan2 jing3 hou2 zing3 soeng4 m4 sai2 gam3 daam1 sam1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a drug’s bodily action in a healthy person, rather than its therapeutic effect.

example.english: The drug’s physiological action in healthy people is mainly to speed up the heartbeat.
example.traditional: 呢隻藥對健康人士嘅生理作用，主要係令心跳加快。
example.jyutping: ne1 zek3 joek6 deoi3 gin6 hong1 jan4 si6 ge3 sang1 lei5 zok3 jung6 zyu2 jiu3 hai6 ling6 sam1 tiu3 gaa1 faai3
